name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3361: hooks/pre-push compared the LISTENER PROCESS START to tv/control_app.py mtime and warned on every push where the file was newer. MEASURED 2026-09-19 on his live console, in one minute: the process started Fri Sep 18 23:37:38, control_app.py was written 2026-09-19 16:48:34 - seventeen hours later, so the heuristic warned - and /api/status answered moduleFreshness known true, stale FALSE, loadedAtMs greater than srcWrittenMs, say: this server is the file on disk. A process can re-exec, a supervisor can reload it, and a module can be imported long after boot, so PROCESS AGE IS NOT MODULE AGE. ⚠⚠ AND THE RIGHT ANSWER HAS EXISTED SINCE v3288 AND NOTHING ASKED FOR IT. module_freshness() captures its own file mtime AT IMPORT and compares it to the mtime now - no PID, no baked literal, no guess about process ancestry - and its own docstring says in as many words that the PID heuristic can be fooled by a supervisor or a re-exec. It is published on /api/status as moduleFreshness and this hook went on timing the PID anyway: an answer built, published and never consumed, which is this repo single most repeated defect wearing a shell script. THREE STATES NOW, NOT TWO: stale warns and names tvd-scan.sh, fresh is silent, and an unreachable console or known=false prints UNKNOWN and explicitly says it is neither a pass nor a failure - because a warning fired on a state nobody measured is precisely the noise this block has been making on every push for weeks. ⚠ THE HEURISTIC WAS WRONG IN BOTH DIRECTIONS, not merely noisy: a console restarted one second before a push would PASS it while serving a module imported hours earlier from a since-rewritten file. Process age can be wrong either way; import age cannot. ⚠⚠ AND THE NEW LAW CAUGHT ITS OWN BAD WINDOW ON ITS FIRST RUN, which is what a law is for: the UNKNOWN-branch case anchored on the bare token, which lands inside the EMBEDDED PYTHON that prints that token, about forty lines above the shell branch that reacts to it - so the window graded the stale branch and reported the unknown one missing. Both branches are now anchored on their shell case labels and bounded at the closing double semicolon rather than by a byte count, and the law REFUSES rather than grading a slice whose far end is a guess. HEART: this version changes a GATE MESSAGE and adds no surface, no lane and no store. The thing it now reads is itself the supervision - control_app.module_freshness, live on /api/status since v3288 - and the new law pins BOTH ends of that join: the hook consuming it and control_app still publishing it, so the hook cannot end up reading a key nothing writes and printing UNKNOWN forever. 480 gates, 5 cases, 3 red-proofs PROVEN. ⚠⚠⚠ AND THIS VERSION ALSO FIXES A REAL DEFECT THE CROSS-FAMILY EYE FOUND IN v3360, WHICH IS ALREADY SHIPPED. v3360 stripped why= ship notes from the whole python diff, and why= is a ship note ONLY in run_gates.py. MEASURED across tv/*.py: 188 occurrences sit outside any Gate( call and many are live message strings - why=boot, why=a session ended, why=disk too full, why=the second-family CLI is not installed here. Stripping those replaces the very bytes a version about wording exists to change and hands the eye a stub in place of its subject, which is the defect this whole area exists to prevent, re-created by the fix for it. The strip now walks the diff FILE BY FILE and touches only the run_gates.py hunks; measured on v3360 own payload that keeps 6,024 of the 7,214 chars it was removing, and across 24 versions the reach is 68 missed files down to 60, 7 better and ZERO worse. ⚠ THE OTHER TWO FINDINGS IN THAT SAME LOOK WERE REFUTED BY MEASUREMENT and are recorded so nobody re-derives them: it said the replacement drops newlines - the shipped code appends one newline per newline in the match, verified 4 to 4 - and that the strip is a no-op after _strip_comments - measured on v3360 own payload at 18,647 chars down to 11,433. It was judging a TRUNCATED payload that cut the replacement line, which is the reach problem this very change exists to reduce. ⚠ AND SCOPING SILENTLY WEAKENED THREE OF THE LAW OWN CASES: their fixtures had no diff --git header, so the scoped strip became a no-op on them and they would have passed over a helper that does nothing. The baseline case caught it, the fixtures now carry the header, and 6 red-proofs across both laws PROVE.
